subject.title: BL-ecommerce-coupons: Coupons & Promotions — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should MiguelHamelyn complete F2 for the current 28-rule Coupons & Promotions block and then publish the single BL PR, or should the block be split before F3/F4?
rationale: The repo's BL pipeline makes owner validation blocking, and automation cannot validate the business rule text or decide whether the accepted oversized block should proceed unchanged.

options.title: Complete F2 on the current block
options.body: MiguelHamelyn validates flags and all 28 rules in bulk, then the existing branch can proceed to F3/F4 and a single BL PR.

options.title: Split before implementation
options.body: Maintainers split the 28 rules into smaller blocks before isolation/tests to reduce review size, at the cost of reworking the current F1 output.

options.title: Defer the BL block
options.body: Leave the mother issue open but pause F2/F3/F4 until the Coupons & Promotions ownership or review bandwidth is clearer.

recommendation.title: Complete F2 on the current block
recommendation.body: MiguelHamelyn validates flags and all 28 rules in bulk, then the existing branch can proceed to F3/F4 and a single BL PR.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned block owner and already confirmed the F0 boundary decision for this issue.
